ResearchTabDef.label: Aquaculture
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Develop constructed ponds into stable, selectively bred aquatic ecosystems.

ResearchProjectDef.label: pondkeeping
ResearchProjectDef.description: Construct shallow ponds, fishing buckets, natural cover, gravel beds, and a sampling station for establishing self-renewing pond communities.

ResearchProjectDef.label: managed aquaculture
ResearchProjectDef.description: Process dead fish into generic fish meat, prepare fish feed, build pond feeders and fishing barrels, and set managed pond harvesting limits.

ResearchProjectDef.label: industrial aquaculture
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlock automatic pond feeders, powered pond aerators, ecosystem and habitat diagnostics, school information, stocking goals, and labor-backed surplus harvest management.

ResearchProjectDef.label: selective fish breeding
ResearchProjectDef.description: Control pond reproduction with egg-removal, feed-supported breeding programs, and permanent medicine-backed sterilization.
